# netbox_custom_field_choice_set (Resource)

A NetBox custom field choice set (extras.customfieldchoiceset).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/extras/customfieldchoiceset/):

Single- and multi-selection custom fields must define a set of valid choices from which the user may choose when defining the field value. These choices are defined as sets that may be reused among multiple custom fields.

A choice set must define a base choice set and/or a set of arbitrary extra choices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_custom_field_choice_set" "test" {
  name        = "test-custom-field-choice-set"
  description = "test-description"
  extra_choices = [
    { value = "a", label = "test-a" },
    { value = "b", label = "test-b" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `base_choices` (String) Predefined set of choices to start from. One of: IATA, ISO_3166, UN_LOCODE.
- `description` (String)
- `extra_choices` (Attributes List) Additional choices as value/label pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extra_choices))
- `order_alphabetically` (Boolean) Sort choices alphabetically instead of by definition order.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.

### Read-Only

- `choices_count` (Number)
- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id of the choice set.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--extra_choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `extra_choices`

Required:

- `label` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_custom_field_choice_set.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_custom_field_choice_set.test 123
```
